faq.title: Frequently asked questions about dental insurance
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about immediate cover, tariffs and the IKK bonus.

items.q: My dentist has already recommended treatment. Can I still sign up?
items.a: Yes, that is exactly what our immediate-cover path is for: with the ZAHN Sofort module, die Bayerische insures treatments that have already been recommended or started, with up to €1,500 towards them (€750 per calendar year) on top of your statutory subsidy. Only the timing matters: you must sign up before your dentist issues the invoice.

items.q: Which path fits me: die Bayerische or UKV?
items.a: One question decides: has your dentist recommended or started a treatment within the last 2 years? If yes, die Bayerische with the ZAHN Sofort module is your path. If no, UKV ZahnPRIVAT gives you strong prevention in three tariff levels. The tariff guide at the top of this page takes you straight to the right sign-up.

items.q: How much does dental insurance cost per month?
items.a: That depends on your age, tariff and situation. Both online calculators show your personal premium within minutes. For orientation: the ZAHN Sofort module of die Bayerische costs €29.90 per month in addition to the chosen dental tariff and ends automatically after 24 months.

items.q: Can I sign up with missing teeth?
items.a: Yes, with UKV: up to 3 already missing teeth are fully co-insured for a fixed surcharge (€6.10 to €10.90 per tooth per month depending on the tier), and the reimbursement scale remains uncut. Timing matters: you must sign up before your dentist recommends the replacement for the gap. die Bayerische currently does not accept missing teeth. From 4 missing teeth there is an immediate-cover solution on the market entirely without health questions, and we name it for you free of charge by phone: +49 40 89755705. Wisdom teeth and a gap closure confirmed by your dentist do not count as missing teeth.

items.q: I recently had periodontitis. Is anything still possible?
items.a: Yes. UKV only looks back 2 years: if the periodontitis is older and nothing has been recommended again since, you do not need to declare it at all. If it is within the last 2 years, UKV still accepts you, with an exclusion only for periodontal treatments, all other benefits apply in full. die Bayerische asks 3 years back and does not accept periodontitis or enamel defects within that period.

items.q: Can I add the immediate-cover module later?
items.a: No. The ZAHN Sofort module of die Bayerische can only be chosen once, at the initial sign-up together with the dental tariff. Adding it to an existing contract is not possible. It ends automatically after 24 months, and your dental tariff then continues as normal. So if something is or could be recommended for you, take the module right away at sign-up.

items.q: How does the IKK bonus refinance the premium?
items.a: IKK classic rewards health-conscious behaviour with a strong bonus programme. How much you get back is individual: depending on your activities, the bonus can fully finance up to 100 percent of your premium. Calculate yours with the bonus calculator on this page.

items.q: Why is signing up before the invoice so important?
items.a: With the immediate cover of die Bayerische, a treatment is insurable as long as it has not been invoiced yet. Once the invoice is written, it is too late for that treatment. So: sign up first, then receive the invoice. Contact us if you have timing questions.

UKV ZahnPRIVAT has no waiting periods in any of its three tiers. The test-winner tariff ZAHN Prestige of die Bayerische has none either, and the ZAHN Sofort module pays from day one. For the other tariffs and benefits, the respective application process shows you the details transparently before you sign up.

problem.title: The Problem: Statutory Health Insurance Covers Almost Nothing
problem.text1: When things get serious at the dentist, it gets expensive. Statutory health insurance funds only pay a small fixed subsidy for dental prosthetics, often less than 50% of the most basic treatment.
problem.text2: High-quality implants, ceramic crowns or inlays must be paid for almost entirely out of pocket. A single bill can quickly amount to several thousand euros. Without supplementary insurance, you're stuck with these costs.
